symptoms.label: Headache / Migraine
symptoms.reason: Neurologists specialize in diagnosing recurrent headaches, migraines, nerve-related cranial pain, and intracranial concerns.
symptoms.advice: Note the trigger factors, frequency, and whether light or sound sensitivity is present.

symptoms.label: Dizziness / Vertigo
symptoms.reason: Vertigo and balance issues commonly stem from inner ear vestibular disturbances, or neurological equilibrium issues.
symptoms.advice: Keep track of whether turning your head triggers spinning sensations.

symptoms.label: Eye Pain / Vision Issue
symptoms.reason: Ophthalmologists handle ocular inflammation, acute eye pain, visual disturbances, and cornea/retina examinations.
symptoms.advice: Avoid rubbing your eyes; seek emergency care immediately if sudden vision loss occurs.

symptoms.label: Blurred Vision / Visual Disturbance
symptoms.reason: Blurred or changed vision requires assessment of the eye and visual system.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency care for sudden vision loss or sudden double vision.

symptoms.label: Red / Irritated Eye
symptoms.reason: Persistent or painful eye redness may require examination for infection or inflammation.
symptoms.advice: Avoid rubbing the eye and seek urgent care if there is severe pain or reduced vision.

symptoms.label: Eye Discharge / Sticky Eyes
symptoms.reason: Eye discharge may occur with conjunctival or other ocular infections.
symptoms.advice: Avoid sharing towels and touching the eye with unwashed hands.

symptoms.label: Ear Pain / Hearing Difficulty
symptoms.reason: ENT specialists treat middle and inner ear infections, eustachian tube blockages, and hearing disturbances.
symptoms.advice: Avoid inserting cotton buds or foreign objects into the ear canal.

symptoms.label: Ringing / Buzzing in Ear
symptoms.reason: Persistent tinnitus may require hearing and ear evaluation.
symptoms.advice: Note whether it is in one or both ears and whether it started suddenly.

symptoms.label: Ear Discharge
symptoms.reason: Ear discharge may occur with ear canal or middle-ear infection and requires examination when persistent.
symptoms.advice: Do not insert cotton buds or liquids into the ear unless advised by a clinician.

symptoms.label: Sore Throat / Difficulty Swallowing
symptoms.reason: Pharyngeal inflammation, tonsillitis, and vocal cord irritation are evaluated by ENT or General Physicians.
symptoms.advice: Stay hydrated and monitor if accompanied by high fever or swollen glands.

symptoms.label: Hoarseness / Voice Change
symptoms.reason: Persistent voice changes may involve the vocal cords or upper airway and can require ENT assessment.
symptoms.advice: Seek evaluation if hoarseness persists or is accompanied by difficulty breathing or swallowing.

symptoms.label: Blocked / Stuffy Nose
symptoms.reason: Nasal blockage is commonly evaluated for allergic, infectious, sinus, or structural causes.
symptoms.advice: Note fever, facial pain, sneezing, or nasal discharge.

symptoms.label: Runny Nose
symptoms.reason: Runny nose commonly occurs with viral infections or allergies.
symptoms.advice: Note associated sneezing, fever, sore throat, or cough.

symptoms.label: Frequent Sneezing
symptoms.reason: Frequent sneezing is commonly associated with allergic or upper respiratory conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note possible triggers such as dust, pollen, pets, or seasonal changes.

symptoms.label: Sinus / Facial Pressure
symptoms.reason: Facial pressure with nasal symptoms can occur with sinus inflammation or infection.
symptoms.advice: Note nasal blockage, discharge, fever, or reduced smell.

symptoms.label: Nosebleed
symptoms.reason: Recurrent or significant nosebleeds may require examination of the nasal passages and contributing factors.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care if bleeding is heavy, persistent, or associated with fainting or significant weakness.

symptoms.label: Neck Pain / Stiffness
symptoms.reason: Cervical spine strain, disc compression, and musculoskeletal stiffness are managed by Orthopedic specialists.
symptoms.advice: Avoid sudden neck jerks; maintain ergonomic posture while reading or working.

symptoms.label: Head Injury / Concussion / Fall on Head
symptoms.reason: Trauma to the head or fall can cause skull fractures, concussions, or acute intracranial hemorrhage.
symptoms.advice: Seek immediate emergency medical evaluation if there is loss of consciousness, repeated vomiting, confusion, or severe worsening headache.

symptoms.label: Seizure / Convulsion
symptoms.reason: A first or unexplained seizure requires urgent assessment.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency care for a first seizure, prolonged or repeated seizures, injury, pregnancy, or persistent confusion.

symptoms.label: Sudden Speech Difficulty / Slurred Speech
symptoms.reason: Sudden speech difficulty can be a neurological emergency.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency care immediately, especially with facial drooping, weakness, numbness, or severe headache.

symptoms.label: Facial Weakness / Drooping
symptoms.reason: Sudden facial weakness can indicate an acute neurological condition and requires prompt assessment.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency care immediately if onset is sudden or accompanied by arm weakness or speech difficulty.

symptoms.label: Tremor / Shaking
symptoms.reason: Persistent or unexplained tremor may have neurological, medication-related, metabolic, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Note whether it occurs at rest, during movement, or with stress.

symptoms.label: Memory Problems / Confusion
symptoms.reason: Persistent memory or cognitive changes require assessment for neurological, metabolic, medication-related, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency care for sudden confusion or rapid change in mental status.

symptoms.label: Common Cold / Flu Symptoms
symptoms.reason: Upper respiratory viral illness causing runny nose, sneezing, mild fever, and malaise.
symptoms.advice: Stay hydrated with warm fluids, rest, and use saline nasal drops or steam inhalation.

symptoms.label: Toothache / Dental Pain
symptoms.reason: Tooth pain is typically caused by dental caries, pulpitis, abscess, or impacted third molars requiring dental examination.
symptoms.advice: Rinse mouth with warm salt water, avoid extreme hot or cold foods, and visit a dentist promptly.

symptoms.label: Mouth Ulcers / Canker Sores
symptoms.reason: Aphthous ulcers or mucosal erosions can arise from stress, vitamin deficiencies, or trauma.
symptoms.advice: Avoid spicy or acidic foods; apply soothing topical oral gel. Consult if non-healing beyond 2 weeks.

symptoms.label: Gum Pain / Swelling / Bleeding Gums
symptoms.reason: Gingivitis, periodontal infection, or food impaction can cause inflamed, painful gums.
symptoms.advice: Maintain gentle brushing, use warm saline rinses, and see a dentist or periodontist.

symptoms.label: Difficulty Swallowing (Dysphagia)
symptoms.reason: Difficulty or pain when swallowing can indicate tonsillar infection, pharyngeal inflammation, or esophageal dysmotility.
symptoms.advice: Eat soft foods and seek urgent care if you cannot swallow liquids or saliva.

symptoms.label: Loss of Smell (Anosmia)
symptoms.reason: Reduced or absent olfaction often follows viral rhinitis, sinusitis, nasal polyps, or neurological causes.
symptoms.advice: Consult an ENT specialist if smell does not recover after resolution of cold symptoms.

symptoms.label: Loss of Taste (Ageusia)
symptoms.reason: Taste reduction is closely linked with olfactory deficit, viral infections, or oral mucosal issues.
symptoms.advice: Note whether loss is complete or partial and whether oral burning is present.

symptoms.label: Chest Pain / Heavy Pressure
symptoms.reason: Chest pressure or pain warrants immediate cardiac evaluation to assess coronary artery circulation and heart function.
symptoms.advice: If the pain radiates to the jaw, left arm, or causes cold sweats/breathlessness, call emergency services immediately.

symptoms.label: Burning Sensation / Acid Reflux
symptoms.reason: Substernal burning after meals is typically gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) or esophageal irritation.
symptoms.advice: Avoid lying down flat immediately after eating and note trigger foods.

symptoms.label: Palpitations / Rapid Heartbeat
symptoms.reason: Irregular rhythm, fluttering sensations, or tachyarrhythmias are investigated by Cardiologists.
symptoms.advice: Monitor if episodes occur at rest or during exertion, and limit caffeine.

symptoms.label: Shortness of Breath / Wheezing
symptoms.reason: Pulmonologists specialize in airways, asthma, bronchitis, and lung parenchymal disorders.
symptoms.advice: Seek immediate medical care if breathing becomes rapidly labored or lips turn pale/blue.

symptoms.label: Persistent Cough
symptoms.reason: Coughs extending past 2-3 weeks require respiratory evaluation, chest radiography, and airway assessment.
symptoms.advice: Note if the cough produces colored phlegm or occurs mainly during night.

symptoms.label: Chest Congestion / Phlegm
symptoms.reason: Chest congestion and phlegm can occur with airway infections, bronchitis, asthma, or other respiratory conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note the color and amount of phlegm and whether there is fever or breathing difficulty.

symptoms.label: Blood in Sputum / Coughing Blood
symptoms.reason: Coughing blood requires medical evaluation to identify the respiratory or other source.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent medical care, especially if the amount is more than a small streak or breathing is difficult.

symptoms.label: Chest Pain When Breathing
symptoms.reason: Pain associated with breathing can arise from the lungs, pleura, chest wall, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care if it is sudden, severe, or accompanied by shortness of breath.

symptoms.label: Fainting / Loss of Consciousness
symptoms.reason: Loss of consciousness can have cardiac, neurological, metabolic, or other causes and requires medical assessment.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care for a first episode, injury, chest pain, abnormal heartbeat, seizure-like activity, or persistent confusion.

symptoms.label: Leg / Ankle Swelling
symptoms.reason: Leg swelling may have cardiac, kidney, venous, medication-related, or local causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care if one leg suddenly swells with pain or if swelling is accompanied by chest pain or breathlessness.

symptoms.label: Stomach Pain / Cramping
symptoms.reason: Gastroenterologists diagnose gastritis, peptic ulcers, gall bladder issues, and digestive tract disorders.
symptoms.advice: Note whether the pain happens before meals, after eating, or wakes you at night.

symptoms.label: Nausea / Vomiting
symptoms.reason: Frequent nausea and gastrointestinal intolerance should be evaluated for viral gastritis or metabolic causes.
symptoms.advice: Sip electrolyte fluids frequently in small amounts to prevent dehydration.

symptoms.label: Bloating / Indigestion
symptoms.reason: Digestive enzyme deficiencies, gut dysmotility, or irritable bowel patterns are treated by gastroenterologists.
symptoms.advice: Keep a 3-day food log to pinpoint specific digestive sensitivities.

symptoms.label: Loose Motion / Diarrhea
symptoms.reason: Diarrhea may result from infection, food-related illness, medication effects, or gastrointestinal disorders.
symptoms.advice: Maintain fluids and electrolytes and seek care for blood in stool, severe dehydration, severe pain, or persistent diarrhea.

symptoms.label: Constipation / Difficulty Passing Stool
symptoms.reason: Persistent constipation may be related to diet, medications, bowel disorders, or other medical causes.
symptoms.advice: Note bowel frequency, stool consistency, abdominal pain, vomiting, or blood in stool.

symptoms.label: Heartburn / Acidity
symptoms.reason: Burning behind the breastbone or upper abdomen can occur with acid reflux and other upper gastrointestinal conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note whether symptoms follow meals or worsen when lying down.

symptoms.label: Blood in Stool / Rectal Bleeding
symptoms.reason: Blood in stool can arise from hemorrhoids, intestinal inflammation, bleeding lesions, or other gastrointestinal causes and should be assessed.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care for heavy bleeding, black stool, dizziness, fainting, or severe abdominal pain.

symptoms.label: Black / Tarry Stool
symptoms.reason: Black tarry stool can indicate bleeding higher in the digestive tract and requires prompt medical evaluation.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent medical care, particularly with weakness, dizziness, vomiting blood, or fainting.

symptoms.label: Yellow Eyes / Yellow Skin (Jaundice)
symptoms.reason: Jaundice can arise from liver, bile duct, blood, or other systemic conditions and requires evaluation.
symptoms.advice: Note dark urine, pale stool, abdominal pain, fever, or itching.

symptoms.label: Abdominal Cramps / Colic Pain
symptoms.reason: Intermittent sharp or twisting abdominal spasms often arise from gastroenteritis, bowel hypermotility, or food intolerance.
symptoms.advice: Apply gentle warmth, sip warm electrolyte fluids, and seek urgent care if cramps become constant, rigid, or accompanied by vomiting.

symptoms.label: Vomiting Blood / Coffee-Ground Vomit
symptoms.reason: Hematemesis indicates acute bleeding in the esophagus, stomach, or duodenum (ulcers, Mallory-Weiss tears, or varices) and is a life-threatening medical emergency.
symptoms.advice: 🚨 Seek IMMEDIATE Emergency Room evaluation (Call 108/911). Do not take food, liquids, or oral medications.

symptoms.label: Lower Abdominal Pain
symptoms.reason: Lower quadrant discomfort may indicate bowel irritation, diverticulitis, or acute appendiceal inflammation.
symptoms.advice: Consult immediately if pain localizes sharply to the lower right side with fever.

symptoms.label: Painful / Frequent Urination
symptoms.reason: Urologists specialize in the urinary tract, bladder infections, urethral inflammation, and kidney stones.
symptoms.advice: Increase fluid intake and avoid holding urine for prolonged periods.

symptoms.label: Pelvic Pain / Cramps
symptoms.reason: Pelvic region issues require targeted evaluation of reproductive organs or lower urinary tract pathways.
symptoms.advice: Document the correlation with menstrual cycles or physical movement.

symptoms.label: Side / Flank / Kidney Area Pain
symptoms.reason: Flank pain may be related to kidney stones, urinary infection, or other urinary or abdominal causes.
symptoms.advice: Note blood in urine, fever, vomiting, or pain radiating toward the groin.

symptoms.label: Blood in Urine
symptoms.reason: Blood in urine can occur with infection, stones, kidney disease, or other urinary tract conditions and should be evaluated.
symptoms.advice: Seek prompt medical evaluation, especially with clots, severe pain, fever, or inability to urinate.

symptoms.label: Difficulty Starting / Passing Urine
symptoms.reason: Difficulty urinating may result from obstruction, prostate problems, infection, medication effects, or other urinary conditions.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care if you are unable to pass urine.

symptoms.label: Urgent / Frequent Need to Urinate
symptoms.reason: Urinary urgency and frequency can occur with urinary infections, bladder conditions, diabetes, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Note burning, fever, blood in urine, increased thirst, or increased urine volume.

symptoms.label: Urine Leakage / Incontinence
symptoms.reason: Urinary leakage can result from bladder, pelvic floor, neurological, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Note whether leakage occurs with coughing, urgency, exercise, or during sleep.

symptoms.label: Urinary Incontinence / Involuntary Leaking
symptoms.reason: Loss of bladder control, stress leakage, or urge incontinence requires evaluation of pelvic floor tone and bladder sphincter mechanics.
symptoms.advice: Limit bladder irritants like caffeine and alcohol; record leaking episodes and discuss with a urologist.

symptoms.label: Suspected Fracture / Broken Arm / Fall Injury
symptoms.reason: Acute trauma, bike falls, or accidents with severe arm pain and difficulty moving the arm strongly indicate a bone fracture (radius, ulna, clavicle, humerus) or joint dislocation requiring urgent X-ray imaging and Orthopedic care.
symptoms.advice: Immobilize and support the arm in a sling or against your body. Do not attempt to force movement or straighten if visibly deformed. Apply ice wrapped in cloth and get an urgent Orthopedic or Emergency Room evaluation with X-rays.

symptoms.label: Shoulder / Elbow Joint Pain
symptoms.reason: Orthopedic doctors assess rotator cuff tears, tendonitis, arthritis, and joint dislocations.
symptoms.advice: Avoid heavy overhead lifting until clinically evaluated.

symptoms.label: Numbness / Tingling in Hand
symptoms.reason: Tingling or pins-and-needles down the arm points to cervical nerve root compression or carpal tunnel syndrome.
symptoms.advice: Note if symptoms worsen when typing or resting your wrist on hard surfaces.

symptoms.label: Muscle Strain / Weakness
symptoms.reason: Musculoskeletal strain or acute trauma to the upper limb is best addressed by Orthopedic specialists.
symptoms.advice: Apply cold compression for acute sprains within the first 48 hours.

symptoms.label: Arm / Hand Swelling
symptoms.reason: Arm or hand swelling may have local, inflammatory, vascular, or systemic causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care if swelling is sudden, severe, painful, or accompanied by chest pain or breathing difficulty.

symptoms.label: Hand / Finger Joint Pain or Swelling
symptoms.reason: Hand and finger joint symptoms may arise from injury, arthritis, inflammation, or other musculoskeletal conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note whether multiple joints are affected and whether there is morning stiffness.

symptoms.reason: Hand and finger joint symptoms may arise from injury, arthritis, inflammation, or other musculoskeletal conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note whether multiple joints are affected and whether there is morning stiffness.

symptoms.label: Suspected Fracture / Broken Leg / Inability to Bear Weight
symptoms.reason: Severe pain, swelling, or inability to bear weight after a fall or accident points toward a bone fracture (tibia, fibula, femur, foot) or major ligament rupture requiring urgent Orthopedic imaging.
symptoms.advice: Do not attempt to walk or bear weight on the leg. Rest, elevate, apply ice wrapped in cloth, and seek immediate Orthopedic or Emergency evaluation for diagnostic X-rays.

symptoms.label: Knee Pain / Swelling
symptoms.reason: Orthopedists diagnose ligament tears (ACL/meniscus), osteoarthritis, patellar tendonitis, and joint effusion.
symptoms.advice: Avoid high-impact jumping or squatting until the joint is evaluated.

symptoms.label: Ankle / Foot Pain
symptoms.reason: Sprains, plantar fasciitis, and stress fractures are managed by Orthopedic and Podiatric specialists.
symptoms.advice: Rest the foot elevated and wear supportive, cushioned footwear.

symptoms.label: Difficulty Walking / Weakness
symptoms.reason: Gait disturbances can be caused by joint degeneration or lumbar nerve root impingement (sciatica).
symptoms.advice: Use support while walking if balance feels compromised.

symptoms.label: Leg / Foot Swelling
symptoms.reason: Leg swelling can have local, vascular, medication-related, kidney, or heart-related causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care if one leg suddenly swells with pain or if swelling is accompanied by chest pain or breathlessness.

symptoms.label: Leg / Foot Numbness or Tingling
symptoms.reason: Numbness or tingling may arise from nerve compression, neuropathy, spine conditions, or other neurological causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care for sudden one-sided weakness or numbness.

symptoms.label: Leg / Foot Numbness or Tingling
symptoms.reason: Numbness or tingling may arise from nerve compression, neuropathy, spine conditions, or other neurological causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care for sudden one-sided weakness or numbness.

symptoms.label: Rash / Redness / Itching
symptoms.reason: Dermatologists manage eczema, contact dermatitis, fungal/bacterial skin infections, and allergic eruptions.
symptoms.advice: Avoid scratching and refrain from applying harsh fragranced lotions.

symptoms.label: Acne / Skin Blemish / Lesion
symptoms.reason: Dermatologists specialize in follicular inflammation, cystic acne, and abnormal mole/pigment changes.
symptoms.advice: Keep the area gently cleansed; do not pop or pinch blemishes.

symptoms.label: Hives / Raised Itchy Rash
symptoms.reason: Hives commonly result from allergic or immune reactions and may require assessment of triggers.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency care if hives occur with swelling of the lips or tongue or difficulty breathing.

symptoms.label: Boil / Skin Infection / Pus-filled Lump
symptoms.reason: Boils and localized skin infections may require medical assessment and sometimes drainage or treatment.
symptoms.advice: Do not squeeze the lesion; seek care if redness spreads, fever develops, or pain is severe.

symptoms.label: Hair Loss
symptoms.reason: Hair loss may have dermatological, nutritional, hormonal, medication-related, or systemic causes.
symptoms.advice: Note whether hair loss is sudden, patchy, or generalized.

symptoms.label: Dry / Cracked Skin
symptoms.reason: Persistent dry or cracked skin can be related to skin conditions, environmental factors, medications, or systemic causes.
symptoms.advice: Note itching, redness, scaling, or new products that may have triggered the problem.

symptoms.label: Non-healing Wound / Skin Ulcer
symptoms.reason: A wound that does not heal normally may require assessment for infection, circulation problems, diabetes, or skin disease.
symptoms.advice: Seek medical evaluation for persistent wounds, increasing redness, discharge, or fever.

symptoms.label: Generalized Itching / Pruritus
symptoms.reason: Widespread itching without obvious rash may relate to dry skin, liver disease, kidney dysfunction, thyroid disorders, or allergic reactions.
symptoms.advice: Use gentle moisturizers, take cool showers, and avoid scratching. Seek evaluation if accompanied by jaundice or dark urine.

symptoms.label: Lower Back Pain
symptoms.reason: Orthopedic spine specialists evaluate lumbar muscle strain, herniated discs, and facet joint arthritis.
symptoms.advice: Avoid heavy lifting or bending from the waist; maintain a neutral spine.

symptoms.label: Upper Back / Shoulder Blade Pain
symptoms.reason: Thoracic paraspinal tension, postural strain, or rib cage mechanics are treated by Orthopedics.
symptoms.advice: Perform gentle chest openers and check desk ergonomics.

symptoms.label: Back Pain with Numbness / Tingling
symptoms.reason: Back pain with neurological symptoms may involve nerve or spinal structures and needs clinical assessment.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency care for new bladder/bowel loss, saddle-area numbness, or severe leg weakness.

symptoms.label: Fever / High Temperature
symptoms.reason: Fever is a common systemic symptom caused by infections and many other medical conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note the temperature, duration, chills, and associated symptoms.

symptoms.label: Fatigue / Extreme Tiredness
symptoms.reason: Persistent unexplained fatigue can have infectious, metabolic, nutritional, hormonal, sleep-related, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Note duration and whether it is associated with sleep problems, weight change, fever, or weakness.

symptoms.label: General Weakness / Low Energy
symptoms.reason: Generalized weakness requires assessment for common systemic, metabolic, nutritional, infectious, or medication-related causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care if weakness is sudden, severe, or affects one side of the body.

symptoms.label: Body Ache / Muscle Aches
symptoms.reason: Generalized body aches commonly occur with infections, fever, exertion, and other systemic conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note whether body aches occur with fever, cough, rash, or recent physical exertion.

symptoms.label: Chills / Shivering
symptoms.reason: Chills can accompany fever and infections and should be evaluated with the associated symptoms.
symptoms.advice: Check your temperature and note whether chills are accompanied by sweating or fever.

symptoms.label: Loss of Appetite
symptoms.reason: Reduced appetite can occur with infections, digestive disorders, medications, metabolic conditions, and other systemic illnesses.
symptoms.advice: Note duration and any associated weight loss, nausea, vomiting, abdominal symptoms, or fever.

symptoms.label: Unexplained Weight Loss
symptoms.reason: Unintentional weight loss may have metabolic, endocrine, gastrointestinal, infectious, nutritional, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Record the amount and time period of weight loss and any change in appetite or bowel habits.

symptoms.label: Unexplained Weight Gain
symptoms.reason: Unexplained weight gain may be related to fluid retention, hormonal conditions, medications, or lifestyle factors.
symptoms.advice: Note how quickly the weight changed and whether there is swelling or breathlessness.

symptoms.label: Weight Gain / Unexplained Weight Increase
symptoms.reason: Sudden or progressive weight gain can reflect hypothyroidism, fluid retention (edema/heart/kidney/liver), medication effects, or metabolic shifts.
symptoms.advice: Monitor whether rapid swelling in feet/abdomen or shortness of breath is present, and consult for thyroid and metabolic testing.

symptoms.label: Swelling of Legs / Body
symptoms.reason: New swelling can have heart, kidney, liver, venous, medication-related, or local causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care if swelling is sudden or accompanied by chest pain or breathing difficulty.

symptoms.label: Generalized Body / Facial Swelling
symptoms.reason: Puffy face, hands, or generalized edema warrants evaluation of renal, hepatic, or cardiac function.
symptoms.advice: Check if swelling is worse in the morning (eyelids/face) or evening (ankles), and see a physician promptly.

symptoms.label: Dehydration / Excessive Fluid Loss
symptoms.reason: Dehydration can result from vomiting, diarrhea, fever, poor intake, or excessive fluid loss.
symptoms.advice: Watch for very low urine output, severe dizziness, confusion, or inability to keep fluids down.

symptoms.label: General Joint Pain / Polyarthralgia
symptoms.reason: Aches or stiffness across multiple joints can indicate rheumatoid arthritis, viral arthralgia, or systemic inflammation.
symptoms.advice: Note morning joint stiffness duration and whether warmth, redness, or swelling occurs in hands/knees.

symptoms.label: Muscle Cramps / Muscle Spasms
symptoms.reason: Painful involuntary muscle contractions frequently arise from dehydration, electrolyte depletion (potassium/magnesium), or strain.
symptoms.advice: Gently stretch the affected muscle, stay well-hydrated with electrolyte fluids, and consult if frequent.

symptoms.label: Excessive Sweating / Hyperhidrosis
symptoms.reason: Diaphoresis may stem from fever, thyroid hyperactivity (hyperthyroidism), hypoglycemia, anxiety, or autonomic dysfunction.
symptoms.advice: Note if sweating occurs at rest in cool rooms, during sleep, or is accompanied by weight loss or tremors.

symptoms.label: Excessive Daytime Sleepiness / Somnolence
symptoms.reason: Extreme daytime drowsiness may indicate obstructive sleep apnea, anemia, vitamin D/B12 deficiency, or narcolepsy.
symptoms.advice: Avoid operating heavy machinery or driving when drowsy; note snoring and seek clinical evaluation.

symptoms.label: Numbness & Tingling (Paresthesia)
symptoms.reason: Pins-and-needles or sensory loss across limbs can indicate peripheral neuropathy, diabetic nerve changes, or vitamin B12 deficiency.
symptoms.advice: Seek immediate emergency evaluation if numbness is sudden, one-sided, or accompanied by weakness or speech difficulty.

symptoms.label: Night Sweats / Soaking Sleep Sweats
symptoms.reason: Drenching sweats requiring clothes changing during sleep warrant investigation for occult infections, lymphoma, or endocrine disorders.
symptoms.advice: Record temperature, note accompanying weight loss or cough, and consult a physician promptly for workup.

symptoms.label: Missed / Delayed Period
symptoms.reason: A missed period can have pregnancy-related, hormonal, stress-related, medication-related, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Consider pregnancy testing when appropriate and note cycle changes or associated pain/bleeding.

symptoms.label: Irregular Periods
symptoms.reason: Irregular menstrual cycles can be related to hormonal, reproductive, metabolic, stress-related, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Track cycle dates, duration, bleeding amount, and associated symptoms.

symptoms.label: Heavy Menstrual Bleeding
symptoms.reason: Heavy or prolonged menstrual bleeding may require evaluation for hormonal, structural, blood-related, or other causes.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care for very heavy bleeding with dizziness, fainting, or severe weakness.

symptoms.label: Abnormal Vaginal Discharge / Itching
symptoms.reason: Changes in vaginal discharge, odor, or itching may occur with infections or other gynecological conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note color, odor, itching, pain, and other associated symptoms.

symptoms.label: Unexpected Vaginal Bleeding
symptoms.reason: Unexpected bleeding may have several gynecological causes and requires assessment based on age, pregnancy status, and severity.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent care for heavy bleeding, fainting, severe pain, or bleeding during pregnancy.

symptoms.label: Pregnancy-related Abdominal / Pelvic Pain
symptoms.reason: Pain during pregnancy requires assessment because the cause can range from benign conditions to pregnancy complications.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent assessment for severe pain, bleeding, fainting, fever, or reduced fetal movement.

symptoms.label: Breast Lump / New Breast Change
symptoms.reason: A new breast lump or persistent breast change should be clinically examined.
symptoms.advice: Arrange a medical examination for a new, persistent, or changing lump.

symptoms.label: Excessive Thirst
symptoms.reason: Persistent excessive thirst can occur with dehydration, diabetes, medications, or other metabolic conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note whether it is accompanied by frequent urination, weight loss, or weakness.

symptoms.label: Excessive Urination
symptoms.reason: Excessive urine production can occur with diabetes, high fluid intake, medications, or other metabolic and urinary causes.
symptoms.advice: Note whether urine volume is actually increased and whether excessive thirst or weight loss is present.

symptoms.label: Unusual Sensitivity to Heat / Cold
symptoms.reason: Persistent temperature intolerance can be associated with thyroid and other metabolic conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note whether it is new and associated with weight, heart-rate, bowel, or sleep changes.

symptoms.label: Neck Swelling / Thyroid-area Lump
symptoms.reason: A swelling in the front of the neck may involve the thyroid and requires clinical assessment.
symptoms.advice: Seek evaluation if the swelling is new, enlarging, painful, or associated with swallowing or breathing difficulty.

symptoms.label: Anxiety / Excessive Worry
symptoms.reason: Persistent or disruptive anxiety may require mental-health assessment, while physical symptoms should also be considered.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent help if anxiety is accompanied by thoughts of self-harm or inability to stay safe.

symptoms.label: Panic Attack / Sudden Intense Fear
symptoms.reason: Panic symptoms can resemble physical conditions, so new or severe episodes may need medical assessment.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency care for new chest pain, severe breathing difficulty, fainting, or other concerning physical symptoms.

symptoms.label: Persistent Low Mood / Depression
symptoms.reason: Persistent low mood, loss of interest, or functional impairment can require professional mental-health assessment.
symptoms.advice: Seek urgent help if you have thoughts of self-harm or suicide.

symptoms.label: Insomnia / Sleep Problem
symptoms.reason: Persistent sleep problems can be related to stress, mental health, medications, sleep disorders, or medical conditions.
symptoms.advice: Note sleep duration, timing, snoring, daytime sleepiness, and stress or mood changes.

symptoms.label: Thoughts of Self-harm / Suicide
symptoms.reason: Thoughts of suicide or self-harm require immediate safety assessment and urgent professional support.
symptoms.advice: Seek emergency help immediately and stay with a trusted person rather than being alone.

outcome_primary_care_migraine.reason: Your headache features are consistent with a migraine pattern. A first or occasional migraine episode is best managed initially by a General Physician, who can confirm the diagnosis and initiate standard treatment.
outcome_primary_care_migraine.advice: Keep a headache diary (triggers, frequency, duration). Avoid known triggers such as skipped meals, poor sleep, or caffeine changes. Your doctor may prescribe triptans if appropriate.

outcome_neurology_migraine.reason: You are experiencing frequent migraines (more than 4 days/month). Neurologists specialise in migraine prophylaxis, acute rescue therapy, and identifying any structural causes for recurrent episodes.
outcome_neurology_migraine.advice: Request a neurology referral from your GP. Preventive medications (beta-blockers, topiramate, CGRP antagonists) or specialised procedures may be appropriate.

outcome_neurology_chronic.reason: Daily or near-daily headaches may indicate Chronic Daily Headache (CDH) or Medication Overuse Headache (MOH), requiring specialist neurological evaluation.
outcome_neurology_chronic.advice: Track all medications taken for headache relief — overuse of painkillers can worsen chronic headache. A neurologist will guide a supervised detox and preventive regimen.

outcome_general_medicine.reason: Your headache is responding to rest and basic pain relief, and no concerning features are present. This is likely a tension-type or stress-related headache best managed at primary care level.
outcome_general_medicine.advice: Stay hydrated, maintain regular sleep, and consider stress-reduction techniques. See a GP if headaches become more frequent or resistant to simple relief.

outcome_neurology_refractory.reason: A headache that is persistent and refractory to standard pain relief warrants specialist evaluation to rule out secondary causes such as raised intracranial pressure, cervicogenic headache, or structural abnormalities.
outcome_neurology_refractory.advice: Avoid exceeding the recommended dose of any pain medication. A neurologist may order imaging (MRI/CT) or refer to a headache clinic.

options.malayalam: അതികഠിനമായ ശ്വാസംമുട്ടൽ, സംസാരിക്കാൻ പറ്റായ്മ, ചുണ്ട് നീലിക്കൽ

options.label: Known asthma or bronchitis flareup with chest tightness and wheezing
Short of breath only when climbing stairs or walking briskly

questions.question: Is your heart racing very fast while at rest, with chest discomfort or dizziness?
questions.manglish: Chumma irikkumbol nenjidippu vegathil aavunno, koodathe thalakarakkamo vishamamo undo?
questions.malayalam: വെറുതെയിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ നെഞ്ചിടിപ്പ് വല്ലാതെ കൂടുന്നുണ്ടോ? തലകറക്കമോ നെഞ്ചിൽ വേദനയോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Racing heart accompanied by chest pain, blackout, or shortness of breath
Occasional missed or fluttering heartbeats without dizziness
Fast pulse related to anxiety, stress, or high coffee/tea intake
options.malayalam: ടെൻഷൻ വരുമ്പോഴോ കാപ്പി കുടിക്കുമ്പോഴോ നെഞ്ചിടിപ്പ് കൂടുന്നത്

questions.question: Is your chest congested with heavy phlegm, rattling sound, or fever?

questions.malayalam: നെഞ്ചിൽ കഫം കെട്ടിക്കിടക്കുന്നുണ്ടോ? ശ്വാസത്തിൽ കുറുകുറുപ്പോ പനിയോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Heavy chest rattling with high fever, rapid breathing, and colored sputum
options.manglish: Nenjil kapham, koodiya pani, shwasam edukal (Pneumonia)
options.malayalam: നെഞ്ചിൽ കഫക്കെട്ട്, കടുത്ത പനി, കിതപ്പ് (ന്യുമോണിയ ലക്ഷണം)

options.label: Productive cough with yellow/green phlegm from viral bronchitis

questions.question: Are you coughing up bright red blood, clots, or just tiny specks in phlegm?
questions.manglish: Kaphathil chora varunnundo, kooduthal chora thuppukayano?
questions.malayalam: കഫത്തിൽ രക്തം കാണുന്നുണ്ടോ? ധാരാളമായി രക്തം ചുമച്ചു തുപ്പുകയാണോ?

options.label: Coughing up pure red blood or blood clots (Medical Emergency)
Tiny red or brownish streaks in mucus during a harsh cough

questions.question: Is the chest pain sharp when inhaling deeply, and is there cough or recent flight/clot risk?
questions.manglish: Ullilekku shwasam edukkumbol kuthunna vedana aano, paniyo chuma undo?
questions.malayalam: ശ്വാസം ഉള്ളിലേക്ക് എടുക്കുമ്പോൾ നെഞ്ചിൽ കുത്തുന്ന വേദനയാണോ? പനിയോ ചുമയോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Sudden sharp breath pain with fast heart rate, coughing blood, or leg swelling (PE risk)
options.manglish: Pettannu kuthunna vedana, nenjidikkal, kaalil vekkam
options.malayalam: പെട്ടെന്ന് ശ്വാസമെടുക്കുമ്പോൾ കുത്തുന്ന വേദന, കിതപ്പ്, കാലിൽ നീര്

options.label: Sharp pain with fever and productive cough (Pleurisy / Pneumonia)
options.manglish: Paniyum chumayum koode ulla kuthal vedana

options.label: Pain worse with twisting or pressing directly on a tender rib

questions.question: Where is the pain located, and is the stomach rigid, board-like, or vomiting blood?
questions.manglish: Vayaru vedana evideyanu, vayaru kattiyayi kidakkunno, chardi undo?
questions.malayalam: വയറുവേദന എവിടെയാണ്? വയർ കല്ലുപോലെ കട്ടിയായിരിക്കുകയോ ഛർദ്ദിയോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Severe pain in lower right side (appendix), rigid belly, or severe vomiting
options.malayalam: വലത് അടിവയറ്റിൽ കഠിനമായ വേദന, വയർ വലിഞ്ഞു മുറുകൽ (അപ്പെൻഡിസൈറ്റിസ് ലക്ഷണം)

options.label: Upper stomach burning pain related to food intake or acidity
Generalized cramping and gas pain relieved by passing wind or stool

questions.question: Do the cramps come in waves with loose stools, or are they related to menstruation?
questions.manglish: Vayaru muriye pidikkunnathupole kuthunno, vayarippilakko periods samayathano?
questions.malayalam: വയർ തിരുമ്മിപ്പിടിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ വേദന വരുന്നുണ്ടോ? വയറിളക്കമോ ആർത്തവവുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ടതോ ആണോ?

options.label: Cramps accompanied by frequent watery diarrhea or fever (Gastroenteritis)
Lower abdominal / pelvic cramping during or before monthly periods
Recurrent cramps with alternating constipation and diarrhea (IBS)

questions.question: Are you unable to keep any liquids down, or is there blood or dark green bile?
questions.manglish: Vellam polum kudikkan pattathe chardikkunno, chardiyil chorayo pacha niramundo?
questions.malayalam: വെള്ളം പോലും കുടിക്കാൻ പറ്റാതെ ഛർദ്ദിക്കുന്നുണ്ടോ? ഛർദ്ദിയിൽ രക്തമോ പച്ചനിറമോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Vomiting blood, coffee ground material, or extreme dehydration
options.malayalam: ഛർദ്ദിയിൽ രക്തം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അമിത ക്ഷീണവും നിർജ്ജലീകരണവും

options.label: Vomited multiple times, cannot keep even water down for > 12 hours
options.malayalam: വെള്ളം കുടിച്ചാൽ ഉടൻ ഛർദ്ദിച്ചു പോകുന്ന അവസ്ഥ

options.label: Mild nausea and sour taste after meals or during travel
options.malayalam: ഭക്ഷണശേഷമോ യാത്ര ചെയ്യുമ്പോഴോ ഉള്ള നേരിയ ഛർദ്ദി തോന്നൽ

questions.question: Does the burning spread into your neck/mouth with sour taste, or feel like crushing chest pain?
questions.manglish: Nenjerichil thondakkottu kayari pulithikattal undo, atho nenjidippodu koodeyano?
questions.malayalam: നെഞ്ചെരിച്ചിൽ തൊണ്ടയിലേക്ക് കയറി പുളിച്ചുതികട്ടൽ വരുന്നുണ്ടോ? നെഞ്ചിൽ ഭാരവും വേദനയും ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Severe burning pressure with sweating, breathlessness, or radiating down left arm
options.malayalam: നെഞ്ചിൽ കടുത്ത അമർത്തലും വിയർപ്പും ശ്വാസംമുട്ടലും (ഹൃദ്രോഗ സാധ്യത)

options.label: Burning in chest/throat worse lying down, sour acid taste in mouth

questions.question: Is the bloating constant and tight, or does it happen right after eating certain foods?
questions.manglish: Vayaru eppozhum vimbithamano, atho bhakshanam kazhikkumbol mathramano?
questions.malayalam: വയർ എപ്പോഴും വീർത്തു കെട്ടിനിൽക്കുകയാണോ അതോ ചില ഭക്ഷണങ്ങൾ കഴിക്കുമ്പോൾ മാത്രമാണോ?

options.label: Rapidly enlarging abdomen, fluid sensation, leg swelling, or loss of weight
options.manglish: Vayaru vellam ketti vekkuka, kaalil vekkam
options.malayalam: വയറ്റിൽ വെള്ളം കെട്ടിനിൽക്കുന്നതുപോലെ പെട്ടെന്ന് വയർ കൂടൽ

options.label: Bloating and fullness after oily/heavy meals, frequent burping
options.manglish: Bhakshanam kazhicha udane vayaru vimbuka, thikattal

questions.question: Is the blood bright red drops in the toilet, mixed in stool, or black sticky tar?
questions.manglish: Chora chuvannu thulliyayi veezhunnathano, malathil kalarnnathano, atho karutha niramano?
questions.malayalam: രക്തം ചുവന്നു തുള്ളിയായി വീഴുന്നതാണോ, മലത്തിൽ കലർന്നതാണോ, അതോ കറുത്ത നിറത്തിലാണോ?

options.label: Large amount of blood clots, dizziness, or weakness
Dark black, sticky, tar-like stool with foul smell (Melena - Stomach Bleed)
options.malayalam: കരിന്താർ പോലെ കറുത്ത ദുർഗന്ധമുള്ള മലം (ആമാശയത്തിലെ രക്തസ്രാവം)

options.label: Bright red drops after passing stool with itching or pain (Piles/Fissure)
options.malayalam: മലശോധനയ്ക്ക് ശേഷം തുള്ളിയായി ചുവന്ന രക്തം വീഴൽ (പൈൽസ്/ഫിഷർ)

questions.question: Is the stool jet-black and sticky like tar, or have you been taking iron tablets?
questions.manglish: Malam nalla karuppu niramano, iron maathirakal kazhikkunno, ksheenamundo?
questions.malayalam: മലം കരിന്താർ പോലെ കറുത്തതാണോ? അയൺ ഗുളികകൾ കഴിക്കാറുണ്ടോ? തലകറക്കമുണ്ടോ?

options.label: Sticky black tarry stools with dizziness, nausea, or stomach ache (Internal Bleed)
Dark greenish-black stool caused by iron syrup/tablets or specific foods
options.manglish: Iron gulika kazhikkunnathu kondu vanna karuppu

questions.question: Did you vomit bright red blood or dark coffee-ground material?
questions.manglish: Chardiyil chuvanna chorayo atho coffee podi pole karutho aano?
questions.malayalam: ഛർദ്ദിച്ചത് ചുവന്ന രക്തമാണോ അതോ കാപ്പിപ്പൊടി പോലുള്ള കറുത്ത നിറത്തിലാണോ?

options.label: Yes — Vomiting blood or coffee-ground vomit (Immediate ER Care Required)
options.malayalam: അതെ — ഛർദ്ദിയിൽ രക്തം (ഉടൻ അടിയന്തിര ചികിത്സ തേടുക)

options.label: Intense sudden urgency with burning and pelvic pain (Active infection)
Sudden strong urge requiring rushing to toilet, without pain

options.label: Complete inability to urinate with painful swollen bladder (Immediate catheter needed)
options.malayalam: മൂത്രം ഒട്ടും പോകാതെ അടിവയർ വീർത്ത് വേദന (അടിയന്തിര ചികിത്സ)

options.label: Takes minutes to start, weak interrupted trickling stream, sensation of incomplete emptying

options.malayalam: മൂത്രം പോകാൻ കൂടുതൽ സമയം എടുക്കൽ, ഒഴുക്ക് കുറഞ്ഞ് തുള്ളിയായി പോവുക

questions.question: Is the urine pink, red, or cola-colored, and is there severe pain or painless bleeding?
questions.manglish: Muthram chuvanna niramano, iduppu vedanayo atho vedanayillaathe chora pokunno?
questions.malayalam: മൂത്രത്തിന് ചുവപ്പോ തവിട്ടോ നിറമാണോ? കഠിനമായ വേദനയോ അതോ വേദനയില്ലാതെ രക്തം പോവുകയാണോ?

options.label: Painless visible red blood in urine (Crucial urology screening for bladder/kidney)
options.malayalam: വേദനയില്ലാതെ മൂത്രത്തിൽ രക്തം പോകുന്നത് (യൂറോളജി പരിശോധന അത്യാവശ്യം)

options.label: Red/pink urine with excruciating sharp flank/groin pain (Kidney Stone)
options.manglish: Nalla iduppu vedana, muthrathil chora (Kidney stone)

questions.question: Is the pain a severe sharp cramp on one side of lower back radiating to groin with vomiting?
questions.manglish: Oru bhagathe iduppil koodiya vedana adivayarilekku padarunno, chardi undo?
questions.malayalam: ഒരു വശത്തെ നടുവിൽ നിന്ന് അടിവയറ്റിലേക്ക് കുത്തിക്കയറുന്ന കഠിനമായ വേദനയാണോ? ഛർദ്ദിയുണ്ടോ?

options.label: Agonizing sharp flank pain coming in waves, unable to sit still, vomiting (Kidney stone)
options.manglish: Sahikkan pattatha iduppu vedana, chardi (Kidney stone)
options.malayalam: സഹിക്കാൻ പറ്റാത്ത നടുവേദന, ഛർദ്ദി (കിഡ്നി സ്റ്റോൺ ലക്ഷണം)

options.label: Dull aching flank pain with high fever, chills, and cloudy urine (Kidney infection)

questions.question: Does urine leak when you cough, sneeze, or laugh, or do you leak before reaching toilet?
questions.manglish: Chumakkumbol muthram pokunno, atho bathroomil ethunnathinu munpe leak aavunno?
questions.malayalam: ചുമയ്ക്കുമ്പോഴോ ചിരിക്കുമ്പോഴോ മൂത്രം പോകുന്നുണ്ടോ? അതോ ബാത്റൂമിൽ എത്തുന്നതിന് മുൻപേ പോവുകയാണോ?

options.label: Leaking small amounts during coughing, sneezing, laughing, or exercising
options.malayalam: ചുമയ്ക്കുമ്പോഴോ ഭാരം ഉയർത്തുമ്പോഴോ അറിയാതെ മൂത്രം പോകുന്നത്

options.label: Sudden overwhelming urge with leakage before reaching the toilet
options.manglish: Muthram thadayan pattathe bathroom ethum munpe pokunnu
options.malayalam: മൂത്രം പിടിച്ചുവെക്കാൻ പറ്റാതെ ബാത്റൂമിൽ എത്തും മുൻപേ പോകുന്നത്

questions.question: Does the pain shoot down into your arm with finger numbness, or is the neck stiff with fever?
questions.manglish: Kazhuthu vedana kayyilekku tharichu varunno, atho kazhuthu thirikkan pattatha paniyo undo?
questions.malayalam: കഴുത്തു വേദന കൈയിലേക്ക് പടർന്ന് മരവിപ്പ് വരുന്നുണ്ടോ? പനിയോ കഴുത്ത് അനക്കാൻ പറ്റാത്ത അവസ്ഥയോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Rigid neck unable to touch chin to chest with high fever and confusion
options.manglish: Kazhuthu anakkan pattilla, koodiya pani, thalavedana
options.malayalam: കഴുത്ത് ഒട്ടും അനക്കാൻ പറ്റാത്ത അവസ്ഥ, കടുത്ത പനി (മെനിഞ്ചൈറ്റിസ് സാധ്യത)

options.label: Sharp electric pain radiating from neck down arm with numbness or weak grip
options.manglish: Kazhuthil ninnu kayyilekku minnal pole vedanayum tharippum
options.malayalam: കഴുത്തിൽ നിന്ന് കൈയിലേക്ക് മിന്നൽ പോലെ പടരുന്ന വേദനയും മരവിപ്പും

options.label: Aching muscular stiffness from sleeping awkwardly or computer posture
options.manglish: Kire naal computer upayogicho urangi eneettapo vanna vedana
options.malayalam: കമ്പ്യൂട്ടർ ഉപയോഗം കൊണ്ടോ ഉറക്കത്തിലെ മാറ്റം കൊണ്ടോ ഉള്ള കഴുത്തുവേദന

questions.question: Is there loss of bladder/bowel control, numbness in groin, or pain shooting down leg?
questions.manglish: Muthram pidichu vekkan pattathirikukayo, kaalilekku valichu vedana undo?
questions.malayalam: മലമൂത്ര നിയന്ത്രണം നഷ്ടപ്പെടുകയോ, അടിവയറ്റിൽ മരവിപ്പോ, കാലിലേക്ക് വലിച്ചുപിടിച്ചുള്ള വേദനയോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Loss of bladder control, groin/saddle numbness, or progressive leg weakness
options.manglish: Muthram poyi pokunnu, kaalukal thalarunnu (Cauda Equina)
options.malayalam: മൂത്ര നിയന്ത്രണം നഷ്ടപ്പെടൽ, കാലുകൾക്ക് ബലക്കുറവ് (അടിയന്തിര ശസ്ത്രക്രിയ ആവശ്യമായേക്കാം)

options.label: Shooting pain down back of thigh/calf with foot numbness (Sciatica/Slipped disc)
Aching localized lower back stiffness after heavy lifting or bending

questions.question: Is the pain all over your body with fever, or localized after heavy workout/injury?
questions.manglish: Shareeram muzhuvan paniyodu koode vedanayo, atho exercise/injury karanamano?
questions.malayalam: ശരീരം മുഴുവൻ പനിയോടുകൂടിയ വേദനയാണോ അതോ വ്യായാമമോ പരിക്കോ കാരണമോ?

options.label: Extreme muscle swelling and pain with cola-colored dark brown urine (Rhabdomyolysis)
Widespread muscle aches across whole body associated with viral fever or dengue
options.manglish: Paniyum shareeram chathachathu pole ulla vedanayum

options.label: Soreness in specific muscle group 24-48 hours after exercise (DOMS/Strain)

questions.question: Is this left arm heaviness with chest pressure, or pain from a shoulder/muscle strain?
questions.manglish: Edathu kayyile bhaaravum nenjerichilum aano, atho kaiyyile pashikku koodiya vedanayo?
questions.malayalam: ഇടതുകൈയിലെ ഭാരവും നെഞ്ചുവേദനയും ആണോ അതോ പേശിവേദനയോ പരിക്കോ ആണോ?

options.label: Aching numbness in left arm accompanied by chest tightness or shortness of breath
options.malayalam: നെഞ്ചിൽ ഭാരത്തോടൊപ്പം ഇടതുകൈയിലേക്ക് പടരുന്ന വേദന (ഹൃദയാഘാത സാധ്യത)

options.label: Pain near elbow or forearm when gripping, lifting, or twisting wrist
options.malayalam: മുട്ടിന്റെ ഭാഗത്തോ കൈത്തണ്ടയിലോ സാധനങ്ങൾ എടുക്കുമ്പോഴുള്ള വേദന

options.label: Ache in upper arm muscle after carrying heavy bags or lifting

questions.question: Can you raise your arm above your head, or is the shoulder joint completely stiff/frozen?
questions.manglish: Kayyu melekkuyarthan pattunnundo, atho tholazha anakkan pattatha reethiyil jam aayo?
questions.malayalam: കൈ മുകളിലേക്ക് ഉയർത്താൻ കഴിയുന്നുണ്ടോ? അതോ തോൾ അനക്കാൻ പറ്റാത്തവിധം മുറുകിപ്പോയോ?

options.label: Severe stiffness, cannot lift arm overhead or reach behind back (Frozen shoulder)
options.manglish: Kayyu pokkan pattatha reethiyil thol vedana (Frozen shoulder)
options.malayalam: കൈ മുകളിലേക്ക് ഉയർത്താനോ പുറകിലേക്ക് തിരിക്കാനോ പറ്റാത്ത തോൾവേദന

options.label: Sharp pain and weakness when raising arm sideways, pain sleeping on shoulder
options.malayalam: തോൾ ചരിഞ്ഞു കിടക്കുമ്പോൾ വേദന, കൈ ഉയർത്തുമ്പോൾ ബലക്കുറവ്

questions.question: Does the knee click, lock, or give way, and is there swelling or difficulty bearing weight?
questions.manglish: Muttil vekkamundo, nadakkumbol chanthathupole aavunno, muttu madakkan pattunno?
questions.malayalam: മുട്ടിൽ നീരുണ്ടോ? നടക്കുമ്പോൾ കാൽ കുത്താൻ കഴിയുന്നുണ്ടോ? മുട്ട് മടക്കാൻ ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടുണ്ടോ?

options.label: Knee popped during twist/sports, severe swelling within hours, unable to step on foot
options.manglish: Muttu thirinjappol pottiya pole, kaal kuthan pattilla (Ligament tear)
options.malayalam: മുട്ട് തിരിഞ്ഞ് പരിക്കേറ്റു, കാൽ നിലത്തു കുത്താൻ പറ്റാത്തവിധം നീര്

options.label: Knee pain worse going down stairs, grating crackling sound, morning stiffness
options.malayalam: പടികൾ ഇറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ കഠിനമായ വേദന, മുട്ടിന്റെ തേയ്മാനം

questions.question: Is there pain on the first steps out of bed in the heel, or a twisted swollen ankle?
questions.manglish: Ravile eneettu nadakkumbol kannankalil kuthunna vedanayo, atho kaal thettiyathano?
questions.malayalam: രാവിലെ എഴുന്നേറ്റ് ആദ്യ ചുവടുകൾ വെക്കുമ്പോൾ ഉപ്പൂറ്റിയിൽ കുത്തുന്ന വേദനയോ, അതോ കാൽ ഉളുക്കിയതാണോ?

options.label: Ankle twisted, rapidly swollen, bruised, cannot walk 4 steps
options.malayalam: കാൽ ഉളുക്കി നീരുവന്നു, നടക്കാൻ പറ്റാത്ത അവസ്ഥ

options.label: Sharp stabbing heel pain during first few steps in the morning (Plantar fasciitis)
options.manglish: Ravile kaal nilathu thodumbol uppooti vedana
options.malayalam: രാവിലെ നിലത്തു കാൽ കുത്തുമ്പോൾ ഉപ്പൂറ്റിയിൽ കുത്തുന്ന വേദന

options.label: Big toe joint suddenly red, hot, swollen, and excruciatingly tender (Gout)
options.manglish: Kaal viralil nalla chuvappum vekkavum vedanayum (Gout)
options.malayalam: കാൽവിരലിൽ പെട്ടെന്ന് അതികഠിനമായ ചുവപ്പും ചൂടും വേദനയും (യൂറിക് ആസിഡ്/ഗൗട്ട്)

questions.question: Is the bone visibly bent, bone piercing the skin, or severe numbness below the injury?
questions.manglish: Ellu odinjo konatayo, chora varunno, kayyilo kaalilo thalarcha undo?
questions.malayalam: എല്ല് ഒടിഞ്ഞു വളഞ്ഞതായോ, തൊലി തുളച്ച് പുറത്തു വന്നതായോ കാണുന്നുണ്ടോ?

options.label: Visible limb deformity, bone piercing skin, or severe acute accident (ER Emergency)
options.malayalam: എല്ല് ഒടിഞ്ഞു വളഞ്ഞു, രക്തസ്രാവം (അടിയന്തിര എമർജൻസി പരിചരണം)

options.label: Direct fall with localized bone tenderness and swelling, but skin closed
options.manglish: Veenu, ellil thottal koodiya vedana (X-ray needed)
options.malayalam: താഴെ വീണതു കാരണം എല്ലിന്മേൽ കഠിനമായ വേദനയും നീരും

questions.question: Is the swelling in one leg only with pain/redness, or in both legs, or facial/lip swelling?
questions.manglish: Vekkam oru kaalil mathram chuvappode aano, randu kaalilumo, atho mughathum chundilumo?
questions.malayalam: നീർക്കെട്ട് ഒരു കാലിൽ മാത്രമായി ചുവപ്പോടെയാണോ, രണ്ട് കാലിലുമോ, അതോ മുഖത്തോ ചുണ്ടിലോ ആണോ?

options.label: Swelling of lips, tongue, or face with throat tightness or hives (Allergic Emergency)
options.manglish: Chundum mughavum veengi, shwasam muttal (Allergy Emergency)
options.malayalam: ചുണ്ടിലും മുഖത്തും നീര്, ശ്വാസതടസ്സം (ഗുരുതരമായ അലർജി അവസ്ഥ)

options.label: One calf/leg suddenly warm, swollen, red, and painful (Deep Vein Thrombosis risk)
options.manglish: Oru kaalil mathram koodiya vekkavum chuvappum (DVT)
options.malayalam: ഒരു കാലിൽ മാത്രം പെട്ടെന്നുണ്ടായ കടുത്ത നീരും ചുവപ്പും ചൂടും

options.label: Both feet and ankles swollen by evening, indenting when pressed
options.manglish: Randu kaalilum viralkondu amarthiyal kuzhi veezhunna vekkam
options.malayalam: രണ്ട് കാലിലും വിരലമർത്തുമ്പോൾ കുഴിയുന്ന വിധത്തിലുള്ള നീര്

questions.question: Is the itching all over the body, worse at night between fingers, or accompanied by yellow eyes?
questions.manglish: Chorichil shareeram muzhuvanundo, rathri koodunno, kannil manja niramundo?
questions.malayalam: ചൊറിച്ചിൽ ശരീരം മുഴുവനുമുണ്ടോ? രാത്രിയിൽ വിരലുകൾക്കിടയിൽ കൂടുന്നുണ്ടോ? കണ്ണിൽ മഞ്ഞനിറമുണ്ടോ?

options.label: Intense full-body itching accompanied by yellowing eyes and dark urine
options.manglish: Shareeram muzhuvan chorichil, kannil manja niram (Liver issue)
options.malayalam: ശരീരം മുഴുവൻ കഠിനമായ ചൊറിച്ചിലും കണ്ണിൽ മഞ്ഞനിറവും (കരൾ സംബന്ധം)

options.label: Severe itching mainly at night, web spaces of fingers, family members also itching
Dry, flaky, itchy patches in elbow creases, knees, or neck

questions.question: Is hair falling out in round coin-shaped bald patches, or overall gradual thinning?
questions.manglish: Mudi vattathil poyathu poleyano, atho thalayil muzhuvanayi poyathano?
questions.malayalam: മുടി വട്ടത്തിൽ കൊഴിഞ്ഞുപോയതാണോ അതോ തലയിൽ ക്രമേണയുള്ള കട്ടി കുറയലാണോ?

options.label: Smooth round coin-sized bald spots on scalp or beard (Alopecia Areata)
options.malayalam: നാണയ വലിപ്പത്തിൽ വട്ടത്തിൽ മുടി കൊഴിഞ്ഞുപോയ പാടുകൾ

options.label: Excessive handfuls of hair shedding after fever, illness, stress, or delivery
options.manglish: Kure mudi kayyil varunnu, pani/stressinu sesham
options.malayalam: പനിയ്ക്കോ പ്രസവത്തിനോ ശേഷം മുടി ധാരാളമായി കൊഴിഞ്ഞുപോകുന്നത്

options.label: Gradual hairline receding at temples or thinning at crown over years
options.malayalam: തലയുടെ മുൻഭാഗത്തോ നെറുകയിലോ മുടി പതുക്കെ കൊഴിയുന്നത്

questions.question: Do your palms and soles sweat constantly, or is it whole-body sweating with racing pulse?
questions.manglish: Kayyo kaalo eppozhum viyarppano, atho shareeram muzhuvan nenjidippodu koodeyano?
questions.malayalam: കൈപ്പത്തിയിലും കാലുകളിലും എപ്പോഴും വിയർപ്പാണോ അതോ നെഞ്ചിടിപ്പോടെ ശരീരം മുഴുവൻ വിയർക്കുന്നതാണോ?

options.label: Dripping sweat on palms and soles since childhood/youth, affecting writing
Generalized sweating, heat intolerance, weight loss, and shaky hands
options.manglish: Choodu thaangan pattilla, shareeram viyarunnu, thalakarakkam
options.malayalam: ചൂട് സഹിക്കാൻ പറ്റായ്മ, ശരീരം മുഴുവൻ വിയർക്കലും വിറയലും

questions.question: Is bleeding occurring during pregnancy, after menopause, or soaking pads rapidly?
questions.manglish: Garbhini aayirikkumbolano, menopause kazhinjo, atho nalla bleeding undo?
questions.malayalam: ഗർഭകാലത്താണോ രക്തസ്രാവം, ആർത്തവവിരാമത്തിന് ശേഷമാണോ, അതോ അമിതമായ രക്തസ്രാവമാണോ?

options.label: Bleeding during confirmed or suspected pregnancy, especially with pain
Any vaginal bleeding occurring years after menopause has stopped
options.manglish: Menopause kazhinju varsham kazhinjittum chora varunnu

options.label: Light spotting between regular menstrual cycles or after intercourse

questions.question: Are you pregnant with sharp one-sided pelvic pain, shoulder pain, or feeling faint?
questions.manglish: Garbhini aano, adivayaril koodiya vedanayo, mayakkamo, chora pokalo undo?
questions.malayalam: ഗർഭാവസ്ഥയിൽ അടിവയറ്റിൽ കഠിനമായ വേദനയോ, രക്തസ്രാവമോ, തലകറങ്ങി വീഴലോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Sharp pelvic cramping, spotting, dizziness, or shoulder-tip pain (Ectopic warning)
options.manglish: Koodiya adivayaru vedana, chora varal, thalakarakkam (Ectopic risk)
options.malayalam: കഠിനമായ വയറുവേദന, രക്തസ്രാവം, തലകറക്കം (എക്ടോപിക് ഗർഭധാരണ സാധ്യത)

options.label: Mild stretching jabbing ache in groin when turning in bed or standing quickly

questions.question: Is the lump firm and painless, or is there nipple discharge, skin dimpling, or redness?
questions.manglish: Maridathil kattiyulla muzha undo, nipple-il ninnu neer/chora varunno, tholi churunganundo?
questions.malayalam: സ്തനത്തിൽ കട്ടിയുള്ള മുഴയുണ്ടോ? മുലക്കണ്ണിൽ നിന്ന് രക്തമോ ദ്രാവകമോ വരികയോ ചർമ്മം ചുളിയുകയോ ഉണ്ടോ?

options.label: Firm painless lump, skin puckering/dimpling, or blood-stained nipple discharge
options.manglish: Vedanayillaatha muzha, tholi churungal, chora varal
options.malayalam: വേദനയില്ലാത്ത കട്ടിയുള്ള മുഴ, തൊലിയിൽ കുഴിവുകൾ, രക്തം കലർന്ന സ്രവം

options.label: Tender swollen lumps in both breasts that increase right before periods
options.manglish: Periods varunnathinu munpe maridathil vedanayum vekkavum
options.malayalam: ആർത്തവത്തിന് മുൻപ് സ്തനങ്ങളിൽ ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന വേദനയും വീക്കവും

options.label: Red, hot, tender breast lump during breastfeeding with fever (Mastitis/Abscess)
options.malayalam: മുലയൂട്ടുന്ന അമ്മമാർക്ക് ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന കഠിനമായ വേദനയും ചുവപ്പും പനിയും
